question: What Are the Main Communication Protocols in PLC?
body_html:
Communication protocols in PLC are sets of rules that let PLCs, sensors, drives, HMIs and SCADA exchange data reliably. Common ones:

ProtocolMediumTypical use
Modbus RTU / TCPRS 485 or EthernetOpen, supported by almost all PLCs
PROFIBUS DP / PAFieldbusFast I/O (DP), hazardous process areas (PA)
DeviceNetCAN busPower and data on one cable
EtherNet/IPEthernetRockwell PLC networks
HARTOn 4 to 20 mA wiresSmart transmitter diagnostics

The choice depends on speed, distance, cost and system architecture.
